reviews.text:
It’s not the right place if you have emergency with your pet, you have to wait minimum 3 hours just to check your dog that’s crazy, they try to scare you about the situation of your dog just with the objective make u pay for your dog stay there They try to scare you about your dog’s diagnosis so that you’ll leave your dog there, where they’ll keep them in a cage for two nights for $3,000, claiming that they can guarantee surgery within two days—and that doesn’t even include the cost of the surgery itself. When you refuse to leave your dog there under those conditions, the way you are treated is not good. I do not recommend this place at all. We were seen by Dr. Anderson and his assistant.

Before bringing your pet to this emergency care facility, I strongly recommend checking other places with good reviews first. Reviews can tell you a lot about the quality of service you may receive, and based on my experience, this was not a good place. When your pet is having an emergency, having to wait for hours is unacceptable. On top of that, I felt that the focus was more on selling additional services than on actually helping and caring for my pet. My experience left me feeling as though they viewed pets simply as animals rather than beloved members of a family.
I had such a great experience here! Everyone made me feel so welcomed and less nervous for my pet. Dr. Fusco was amazing and very knowledgable. Really recommend bringing your pets here!

if i can give this place ZERO STARS I WOULD. my dog got a hold of a large toad in my backyard and started seizing. They started asking a bunch of financial questions and finding out that i don’t have almost 2,000 to pay for coming to find out (from another vet)  nothing. They told us “ i cant touch ur dog if she has another seizure because you can’t pay us the $2,000) they told us she was so bad that they have to PUT HER TO SLEEP!!!!!!! THEY WERE ONLY SAYING THAT BECAUSE I DIDNT HAVE THE MONEY!!! they were going to literally kill my dog because i couldn’t pay this vet is TERRIBLE DO NOT GO HERE!!!! ALL THEY CARE ABOUT IS MONEY. NOT UR PET. They made it seem like she was still doing bad and seizing so bad that they “had to put her to sleep” but when i asked if i can see here they kept looking at each other and finally let me see her. she was fine. She was awake, alert, and didn’t need to get out to sleep WHATSOEVER. we had to go to a whole other vet that actually cared and helped us.

Excellent care at Miami Veterinary Specialists. The entire team treated my dog ​​Gala with so much love, professionalism, and dedication during a very difficult time for us. I felt at ease knowing she was in good hands. So grateful to the whole MVS team. ❤️🐾 …

Very professional from 1st visit to surgery. Procedure was explained clearly. Our dog Max came home the day after surgery. He has been doing great, taking all his medications, there has been no complications with him. Thank you for everything Miami Veterinary Specialist.
Great experience! My 80 pound pitbull Butters needed a CCL surgery which they walked me through. They were all so friendly there. Recommend
Had such an amazing time there the staff did such a great job with my little pussy thank you !!!

They made you an appointment for 12 noon and at 1PM your pet it’s stressed cause still on the box without any specialist help or even check it.
Never again!!!

Meddi loves her doctor, Dr. Perez! Each staff member here is an angel. They will go to worlds end to make sure our family member souls is treasured. Beyond the deepest gratitude to these angels. Thank you so much VCA Animal Hospital. Forever loyal to your empire!!

Honestly very professional vet. We brought our dog in for a very scary surgery that was an ER visit. They attended to her right away and provided us with updates. When they found out the problem they quickly took her in for surgery and saved her. I am forever grateful to the team at MVS and will recommend them to anyone for saving our 2 year old golden.

THANK YOU <3
I brought my dog Nala here after another dog attacked her. Everyone acted quickly and provided quality care while keeping me informed of what was happening.

Do your homework before you take your beloved pet to MVS. Our little girl was transferred to this hospital from VEG on Biscayne Blvd in Miami. We were presented an estimate of 22k. We paid close to 12k as we were so desperate to help our baby girl. She was placed in the care of Dr. Perez. I really have nothing to say about him although I was never told the seriousness of her pneumonia. I DO HAVE a lot to say about heartless/rude and most disgusting person I have ever met. Do your homework. They will now have COMPETITION as a new vet has opened in their area. Dr Projec.  He’s the best doctor I have met. Most honest/ knowledgeable and compassionate vet you will meet. My little girl
passed away while in the care of Anderson. Can’t even call him a vet. We were refunded -1.200 and a dead dog. We will regret this the rest of our lives for not following our gut instinct. Money is what they’re about.
This place is also a joke. I had my baby’s ashes at home and I kept getting calls to come pick up her ashes. Totally incompetent staff.

Been here a couple times and they just really seem like they want your money. The front desk lady and person who answers the phone are of no help at all and are incompetent. Once we left our dog there to get shots, nail trimming dental cleaning, paid a handsome amount and came back to pick him up, and his nails weren’t even cut and his teeth, weren’t even clean. I also called them about an emergency, and there was no direction nor help they just said they can take him for an emergency fee.

Forever grateful to Miami Veterinary Specialists for taking such incredible care of our little Bucky🐾When we took Bucky he was with distress breathing and tongue was blue. Previous hospital told us to put him down and that was the most painful words I heard that night. When we got to MVS it was only a matter of seconds and they took him in right away. MVS brought us Bucky back to life and he’s at home now. THANK YOU!
